DirectConstraint: Isolated foundresses can rear first workers and lose mass. Body composition and successful timing depend on stage and assay.
ReasonableBoundedHypothesis: Finite mobilizable maternal fuel and protein with locally committed lay and larval provision and separate hydration.
ParameterUseAndBounds: Use starting wet mass as a plausibility bound and N27 order-of-magnitude adult demand. Effective fuel access and egg debits have declared C or D ranges.
RetainedNegatives: Keep twelve WP-5 care-on/off failures and WP-4 maternal and worker reserve stress with true crop and absorption history.
MandatoryRemediation: Provide funded egg and larval resources through actual maternal actions. A hidden supplement or automatic successful cohort fails.
ConditionalAcceptanceTarget: Warm sheltered founder pattern with reserve decline and first worker capability across the frozen ordinary parameter envelope and clear adverse failures.
ExcludedScope: Field survival and universal founder success. No inference of age-specific natural fecundity.
SourceLocators: B01 §3.8 Fig. 4a; B03 Fig. 1 and Appendix S2; FT01 Figs. 5–9; Keller and Passera 1990 Table I; WP-4 and WP-5

DirectConstraint: Observed contacts and trophallaxis networks support ingredient movement and distinct contact and transfer endpoints.
ReasonableBoundedHypothesis: Local accessible receiver deficit and finite dose through existing contact rules and explicit delayed uptake.
ParameterUseAndBounds: Bound dose by donor substrate and receiver capacity. Delay and ingredient targeting remain C/D engineering sensitivities. No worker exchange parameter changes in first pilot.
RetainedNegatives: Retain zero/no attempt and actual rejection. Keep WP-4 before/on-pulse and unfed death with crop stock cases.
MandatoryRemediation: A transfer needs actual local contact and positive debit. Crop acquisition and assimilation require separate accounting and timing.
ConditionalAcceptanceTarget: Small supported group with contact and intake patterns and scarcity failures. Founder ration narrowly qualifies with local contacts only.
ExcludedScope: Measured adult dose distribution and physiological uptake time prediction require matched observations.
SourceLocators: B08 reported spatiotemporal worker network; N01 food type and duration assays; B07 congener tracer; RM-02-R1 and WP-4

DirectConstraint: B01 care scans and B02 ten-minute placements are quantitative within their respective apparatus and observation units.
ReasonableBoundedHypothesis: Use admitted local contact and custody with actual care outcomes and explicit incomplete trips.
ParameterUseAndBounds: Handling and search rates stay bounded hypotheses outside their study windows. Keep existing range and test access and care enrollment in WP-6B.
RetainedNegatives: B01 developmental/worker access differences. B02 placement/time mismatch and WP-2 barrier and failed approach. WP-5 founder care without first workers.
MandatoryRemediation: Separate care work from actual nutrition. No transport or feed through a wall and no inferred dose from handling.
ConditionalAcceptanceTarget: Limited intact shelter and verified local contact. Distinguish worker transport from queen care and positive feeding.
ExcludedScope: General search fidelity and condition-mismatched placement timing or caregiving efficacy.
SourceLocators: B01 Methods and Figs. 3–4; B02 10-minute assay; WP-2 and WP-5

DirectConstraint: Nominal 25 °C population-specific egg larval and prepupal/pupal observation ranges are quantified. Known-age cohort viability is unresolved.
ReasonableBoundedHypothesis: Stage-specific funded maintenance and separate elapsed clock with nutrient readiness at larva-to-pupa.
ParameterUseAndBounds: Use the B06 population and conditions separately. Egg and pupa stores and rates remain C/D hypothesis intervals with explicit low-stock failures.
RetainedNegatives: Keep legacy original-budget early death at warm clock plus positive engineering sentinels and death at exact timing ties.
MandatoryRemediation: Distinguish stage costs and separate initial/own stores. Preserve failed/dead/censored development as outcomes.
ConditionalAcceptanceTarget: Stage transitions and viable first workers in the admitted warm profile with stage timing and resource trajectory constraints.
ExcludedScope: A transferable thermal response and lower temperature arrest and seasonal or age-specific risk outside the trial.
SourceLocators: B06 Table 2 nominal 25 °C cohorts; B07 repeated censuses; RM-01 and WP-4

DirectConstraint: N27 resting O2 and B3 studies bound order of magnitude and conditional task behavior. Task-state occupancy is a different observable.
ReasonableBoundedHypothesis: Separate actual motor bouts from program labels. Use bounded resting demand and a declared active increment until measured.
ParameterUseAndBounds: N27 plus 20.1 J/mL conversion gives a founder test range with uncertainty. Keep activity cost as fixture and test accounting separately.
RetainedNegatives: WP-2 high occupancy versus active-motion mismatch. Preserve stationary task and energy cost controls.
MandatoryRemediation: Count actual activity or explicitly leave it unobserved. No program occupancy claim as empirical activity time.
ConditionalAcceptanceTarget: Energy trends and limited activity states within observed shelter and early worker conditions after matched sensitivity.
ExcludedScope: Age-specific division of labor and temperature- or caste-general activity costs.
SourceLocators: N27 Table 1 and Fig. 3; B04 bioenergetic context; B3-T01/T06/T09; WP-2

DirectConstraint: Batch 2 track studies constrain unloaded trajectories and arena choices. Cue access and loaded return are condition-specific.
ReasonableBoundedHypothesis: Finite local detection and route memory with verified resource access and reversible obstacle handling.
ParameterUseAndBounds: Bound local perception by visible/accessible geometry. Speed and memory outside published conditions remain engineering sensitivities.
RetainedNegatives: Preserve naive failures and WP-3 wall and depletion controls. Include WP-5 closed-cavity zero delivery as negative access evidence.
MandatoryRemediation: Demonstrate collected and delivered material with true route clearance and honest blocked returns in the admitted map.
ConditionalAcceptanceTarget: Surface/shelter assays with known reachability and documented cue/experience controls. Normal and blocked paths differ.
ExcludedScope: Arbitrary underground navigation and out-of-sight search and loaded trajectory prediction outside matching assays.
SourceLocators: B2-F01/F03 shared track sources and foraging assays; WP-3 and WP-5

DirectConstraint: Direct following learning and deposition assays support response in specific circumstances. They do not identify whole scout to naive recruitment benefit in the current Core.
ReasonableBoundedHypothesis: Local cue-mediated activation hypothesis with matched scout-sham comparison and actual departure and food return.
ParameterUseAndBounds: Keep cue persistence and deposition as condition bounds. A threshold or global trail attraction weight does not stand in for recruitment.
RetainedNegatives: WP-3 shared-route occupancy without verified causal activation. Preserve no/blocked signal and naive non-return controls.
MandatoryRemediation: For an admitted recruitment claim show change in naive departure and discovery linked to local cue from real scout plus return. A field-only preference is insufficient.
ConditionalAcceptanceTarget: A later narrow scout and naive assay with bounded causal effects and failure/control cases. Limited trail following retains its engineering scope today.
ExcludedScope: Field population recruitment rates and universal trail advantage.

DirectConstraint: Known-age worker survival and overwintering comparisons provide direct study endpoints under different housing and exposure.
ReasonableBoundedHypothesis: Short active-window depletion-dominated scope first. Reassess residual risk after maternal and brood budgets and intake have been corrected.
ParameterUseAndBounds: Lifetime hazard remains unestimated. Use measured starting and terminal stage denominators and hold exposure/horizon explicit.
RetainedNegatives: WP-5 energy/dehydration/fixture causes and right-censored cases. Retain under-threshold larvae with unknown future fate.
MandatoryRemediation: Do not conflate depletion causes with natural mortality. Check normal and adverse survival with stage and uptake evidence before considering an extra hazard.
ConditionalAcceptanceTarget: Cohort survival and failures under bounded active windows and credible exposure with no universal survival guarantee.
ExcludedScope: Winter mortality and mature or multi-year demographic extrapolation.
SourceLocators: B3-P01 Figs. 1–3 Table 1; B3-P12 Figs. 1–5; B3-P02 diet; WP-5

DirectConstraint: Real group excavation and CT contexts constrain initiation and structure outcomes at their own substrate and scale.
ReasonableBoundedHypothesis: Bounded local excavation and transport on measured fixed substrate using swept geometry. A small change to site feedback would need separate approval.
ParameterUseAndBounds: Use actual dry/wet mass per volume and clearance. Substrate response rates and space demand proxy stay uncalibrated.
RetainedNegatives: Keep roomy isolated and rock-shield zero digs. Preserve identical wet-mass volume and lack of joint external intake and maintenance.
MandatoryRemediation: Qualify initiation transport deposition and obstruction. Geometric resemblance or conserved soil alone is insufficient.
ConditionalAcceptanceTarget: Limited fixed-substrate chamber construction with actual connected paths and time/mass endpoints.
ExcludedScope: Mature architecture or seasonal soil response and automatic restoration after permanent barrier.
SourceLocators: B3-N01/N02/N03/N05; Leckie sham processed CT; WP-5
